channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta launches six new air quality monitoring systems
item.description: Delhi Chief Minister Rekha Gupta launched six new Continuous Ambient Air Quality Monitoring Systems (CAAQMS) and flagged off the 'Vayu Rakshak' fleet to strengthen year-round, data-driven efforts to combat air pollution in the capital.

item.title: Confident Group assures stability, denies financial stress after chairman's death
item.description: Confident Group Managing Director T.A. Joseph said Roy's absence would not disrupt projects or client commitments, stressing that Confident Group is a "zero-debt company" with no borrowings from banks, private institutions or individuals.

item.title: Sonam Kapoor wears bralette-style blouse for traditional baby shower; schooled for flaunting baby bump
item.description: Sonam Kapoor, who is all set to welcome her second child with Anand Ahuja, hosted an elegant godh bharai ceremony at her residence. For the traditional baby shower, Sonam chose a lime-green lehenga paired with a matching dupatta.

item.title: K'taka Congress crisis escalates with fresh call for Shivakumar as CM
item.description: The leadership crisis within the Karnataka Congress has intensified as Deputy Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar's loyalists openly demanded that he be given a chance to serve as Chief Minister.

item.title: Budget debate heats up: Chidambaram calls Budget 2026–27 'forgettable' as UP Assembly opens amid SP's 'Governor Go Back' protests
item.description: Congress leader P. Chidambaram criticised the Union Budget 2026–27 as "forgettable," highlighting high youth unemployment, weak investment, and slowing growth, while accusing the government of ignoring the Economic Survey's warnings.

item.title: Rahul Gandhi says LS Speaker 'committed' to allow him to speak, Rijiju hits back
item.description: Rahul Gandhi said Speaker Om Birla had assured him a chance to speak before the Budget debate, a claim denied by Minister Kiren Rijiju. The row led to repeated disruptions as Opposition MPs demanded Gandhi be allowed to speak out of turn.

item.title: IND vs PAK: PCB's revenue, handshake demands rejected by ICC as T20 World Cup 2026 standoff deepens
item.description: The ICC-PCB meeting in Lahore lasted about 6 hours and the PCB have laid out of demands for them to end the IND vs PAK boycott.

item.title: Manipur violence: 21 houses burnt in Ukhrul clashes, Tangkhul Naga and Kuki residents flee villages
item.description: Fresh violence broke out in Manipur's Ukhrul district on Monday afternoon after armed miscreants allegedly set fire to more houses in Litan Sareikhong village, officials said.

item.title: Is Divya Agarwal living separately from husband Apurva Padgaonkar? Actor's team responds to Bhavya Singh's remark

item.title: J&K enter Ranji semifinals for first time, Auqib Nabi shines
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir created history by qualifying for the Ranji Trophy semifinals for the first time after defeating Madhya Pradesh by 56 runs. Pacer Auqib Nabi starred with a sensational 12-wicket haul.
